issue.title: Let a crew worker run on a different model than the coordinator
issue.body:
### What would you like?

When I start a crew I'd like to pick the model for each worker, e.g. a cheap model for search tasks and a strong one for the hard edits. Right now every worker seems to inherit the coordinator's model.

### Why?

Cost — most crew tasks are simple.

candidates.title: Crew board should show which model each worker used
candidates.body: It would be nice to see the model per task on the board.
